ERRORS IN AUTOMATED GEARBOX CONTROL UNIT CHECK

All OK

Problems encountered

Operation

Check that there are no errors in the automated gearbox control unit. More specifically:

- Clutch sensor error

- Lever switch error

- Even gears engagement error

- Odd gears engagement error

- Clutch solenoid current error

- Electro-magnetic brake error (Selection solenoid)

Move on to Step 2

Errors present.

Continue as instructed by the diagnostic equipment
